snippet.title: Desktop Fishes | Trailer
snippet.description:
Desktop Fishes transforms your screen space into an interactive aquarium filled with adorable, vintage pixel-art fish. They accompany you as you work on your computer, seamlessly integrating into your workflow without getting in your way.
Read more: https://80.lv/articles/add-cute-companions-to-your-screen-space-with-this-upcoming-game

Try the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3618880/Desktop_Fishes/
